summary: Magic Empire Global Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing and closing of a registered direct offering of 2,678,572 units at US$1.12 per unit, with each unit comprising one Class A ordinary share and a one-year warrant exercisable at US$1.12. Gross proceeds were approximately US$3 million, placed on a best-efforts basis by Chaince Securities, LLC, which received a 7.0% cash fee. On a US-equivalent basis, this is an ordinary registered equity financing off an effective Form F-3 shelf, not a special situation; watch for warrant overhang and potential dilution.
